title: How does AI research niche companies with no coverage for you?
author: Elegant-Conflict3910
selftext: Hi all, I’m curious how everyone is having AI research small cap companies that don’t have any research or coverage on them. I have this idea for a product to build that could save a lot of folks time and money, but I need to know if the need is there. Does your AI just check out the SEC filings? Does it check something else? How many tokens are you burning on this research? Thanks!

comments.author: QuanTradin
comments.body: for microcaps with no coverage the filings are most of it, but the 8-Ks and the S-1 or 424B prospectus matter more than the 10-K. dilution history (ATM programs, warrants, reverse splits) tells you more about a tiny company than any summary does. a tool that flags a new shelf filing the day it lands is something people would actually pay for.

replies.author: Elegant-Conflict3910
replies.body: I might actually build this feature. There’s really nothing like that? I could make this cheap.

replies.author: QuanTradin
replies.body: pieces exist. EDGAR has free RSS feeds by form type, and Dilution Tracker covers the small cap dilution side for a monthly fee. what I haven't seen done cheaply is the plain words part, a new 424B lands and you get two lines on what it does to the float that same morning.
